newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Baltrans acquires Fond Group of U.S..
newsitem.headline: Baltrans acquires Fond Group of U.S..

text.p: Freight forwarder Baltrans Holdings said on Wednesday its Baltrans International Ltd unit had acquired 67.4 percent of the U.S.-based Fond Group for a consideration of HK$32.2 million.
Fond Group comprises Fondair Express (HK) Ltd, Fondocean Express (HK) Ltd and Fond Express (USA) Inc, with combined annual turnover of about HK$300 million, it said.
"The synergistic aquisition will increase the overall negotiability of the Baltrans Group on trans-Pacific segments, and hence strengthen our leading position," Baltrans said.
The Fond Group is headquartered in Los Angeles and specialises in shipping cargo from Hong Kong to West Coast gateways in the United States.
Baltrans offices in Los Angeles and San Francisco primarily promote air and sea traffic from the Baltrans network in Asia.
